# Northern salmon

Type: Fish | Internal ID: fish10 | Source: Fishing | Usage: Decoration | Cooking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Northern salmon are passive creatures (fish) found in the waters of the Deep North biome.
They can be caught with a fishing pole using Frosty fishing bait which can be made at the Food preparation table by combining 20 Fishing bait and a Drake trophy.
Needed to craft a Fishing hat

## Notes

• Has a unique line: "Once I was free to jump upstream. But no longer."

Categorias: Fish, Fishing
